note: The language pack's vendoring route table: which upstream files, from
which repo at the shared tag, land where in this pack's scaffold — and
how they are adapted on the way in. Hand-maintained.
`node build/vendor.js` executes it and writes test/vendored.json (the
manifest the guard reads); --check verifies without writing.
THIS ROOT EXISTS BECAUSE THE PACK'S SCAFFOLD IS OUTSIDE SDKGEN'S.
sdkgen's own ts/vendor/routes.json records dart, haskell and lean as
EXCLUDED, saying they need their own route root in this repository. This
is it. Without one, a pack's vendored files are committed content with
nothing verifying they still match upstream — which is what they were
between the pack's creation and this table.
`version` is HAND-SET per route: the port's own declared version at the
tag where it declares one, the tag string where it declares none.
haskell's omni port is what makes the target FULL tier: driving the
shared corpus needs the shared runner, and every FULL target has it.
